name: Grammarly
desc: AI writing assistant for grammar, clarity and tone across every app.
desc_zh: 覆盖全应用的 AI 写作助手，管语法、清晰度与语气。
solves: Catches grammar and tone problems as you write, wherever you write.
solves_zh: 在哪个应用里写都能实时挑出语法和语气问题。
best_for: Reaching for it when you write a lot and want the basics fixed without leaving your document.
best_for_zh: 写得比较多、又不想为了改基础错误而离开当前文档时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Similarweb global AI traffic list, #21 with ~62.9M monthly visits。来源：https://www.grammarly.com/blog/a-history-of-innovation-at-grammarly/ 2026-11-25：公司于 2025-10-29 更名为 Superhuman，Grammarly、Coda 与 Superhuman Mail 归入同一品牌（官方公告：https://www.grammarly.com/blog/company/announcing-company-rebrand-to-superhuman/ ）。本档按产品名保留；新品牌的助手产品见 superhuman-go 档
